sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD 80/EA, Barking Station.
The current record gives 1193 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 2.56ha.
The register explicitly says only part of the site is permissioned, for 198 new homes at Trocoll House.
The status field is permissioned but is constrained by the part-permission note.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an exact EA allocation or HMLR polygon.
The October 2015 Committee considered 15/00651/FUL for Trocoll House and car park, comprising 198 PRS homes and commercial uses.
The September 2020 Committee considered 18/01927/FUL for 198 Build to Rent homes, replacement public house and commercial floorspace.
Committee delegated grant subject to Mayor/Natural England direction, S106 and conditions, with a 14 March 2021 legal-agreement deadline or extension/refusal power.
The revised Trocoll proposal included 35% affordable housing; this mix belongs to the 198-home subsite scheme.
March 2021 Cabinet described up to 198 homes, 35% affordable, under an agreement-for-lease proposal and stated planning approval had been secured.
Cabinet finance/lease arrangements are delivery and governance evidence for Trocoll, not proof that all 1193 EA capacity is consented.
LBBD's Brownfield guidance keeps the permission requirement separate from allocation capacity.

examples.result: EA retains 1193 capacity while only the 198-home Trocoll component is explicitly part-permissioned.
The permissioned field is not read as full-site permission.
The 2015 and 2020 Trocoll cases are historical application lineage, not separate additive 198-home blocks.
35% affordable belongs to the Trocoll scheme and is not transferred to all EA capacity.
Agreement-for-lease and finance decisions are not parcel ownership/title proof.
Point geometry is not an allocation red-line.
Promotion remains zero until exact remaining-site cases, HMLR relation and overlays are verified.

candidate_summary.register_note: Only part permissioned for 198 new homes at Trocoll House
